request_body.raw_goal: Train for a half-marathon. Race is in 10 weeks. I have a training plan — I need the system to help me track execution and not fall behind.

proposed_milestones.description: Peak intensity phase followed by a structured physiological taper.

success_metrics: Completion of at least 90% of the prescribed weekly mileage and interval sessions.

Successful completion of the half-marathon race without injury or unplanned mechanical failure.
